mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.avatar, n.title, n.note_type AS noteType, n.location_or_url AS locationOrUrl, n.content, n.summary, n.cover_image AS coverImage, n.view_count AS viewCount, n.is_deleted AS isDeleted, n.is_pinned AS isPinned, n.is_public AS isPublic, n.created_at AS createdAt, n.updated_at AS updatedAt, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_like l WHERE l.note_id = n.id), 0) AS likeCount, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_favorite f WHERE f.note_id = n.id), 0) AS favoriteCount, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_comment c WHERE c.note_id = n.id AND c.is_deleted = 0), 0) AS commentCount, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_note_like current_like WHERE current_like.note_id = n.id AND current_like.user_id = #{currentUserId} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isLiked, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_note_favorite current_favorite WHERE current_favorite.note_id = n.id AND current_favorite.user_id = #{currentUserId} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isFavorited FROM t_note_like nl INNER JOIN t_note_item n ON n.id = nl.note_id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id = n.user_id WHERE nl.user_id = #{userId} AND n.is_deleted = 0 AND (n.is_public = 1 OR n.user_id = #{currentUserId}) ORDER BY nl.created_at DESC, nl.id DESC
